messages:
priya_gupta: EDR on dev-laptop-17 flagged suspicious LD_PRELOAD usage by /tmp/.libcrypto.so; process=python3 pid=4821. Device auto-quarantined. Anyone available to take?
secbot: Alert created | rule=ldpreload-suspicious | severity=high | action=quarantine | alert_id=EDR-2026-4821 :rotating_light:
jamie_oncall: oncall here, assigning taylor_forensics. Can you pull offline snapshot and collect lsof /proc/4821/maps? Don't let user reboot.
taylor_forensics: Copying commands to run via remote session:
```
sudo journalctl -u edr-agent -n 200
sudo ls -la /tmp/.libcrypto.so
sudo strings /tmp/.libcrypto.so | head -n 50
sudo lsof -p 4821
sudo cat /proc/4821/environ | tr '\0' '\n' | grep LD_PRELOAD || true
``` 
alex_kim: That's my laptop. I got the popup and clicked 'quarantine', i'm working on a patch. I'm at home — can we remote? 
jamie_oncall: Don't reboot or install updates. taylor, can you remote into our MDM session and collect the files? If not, ask Alex to run the commands and paste output. 
alex_kim: Running commands now, pasting outputs. 
alex_kim: `ls -la /tmp/.libcrypto.so` -> `-rwxr-xr-x 1 alex staff 237120 Jun 2 09:12 /tmp/.libcrypto.so`
alex_kim: `cat /proc/4821/environ | tr '\0' '\n' | grep LD_PRELOAD` -> `LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/.libcrypto.so`
taylor_forensics: Looks like a typical load-time hijack. Check process ancestry and network connections. `sudo pstree -sp 4821` and `sudo ss -pan | grep 4821` 
alex_kim: `pstree` shows `init---sshd---bash---python3(4821)` ; no outgoing established sockets in `ss -pan` 
priya_gupta: Any sign of data exfil? browser creds? Did process access ~/.aws/credentials or chrome profile? 
jamie_oncall: From initial EDR telemetry, there were file reads under `/home/alex/.cache` at 09:11 but no outbound IPs. Still treat as high. taylor, mark device compromised and start host-level triage. 
taylor_forensics: Will escalate to IR. Plan: 1) Isolate network (already quarantined) 2) Collect full disk image via fw and store in secure bucket 3) Rotate any AWS/SSH keys used on device 4) Reimage machine for developer 5) Create IOC list and search fleet for /tmp/.libcrypto.so and matching mmap signatures 
priya_gupta: I'll coordinate key rotation and add to incident doc. Alex please list any terminals/tmux sessions and recent `git push` activity. 
alex_kim: I had two terminals; only one push an hour ago to feature branch. No secrets knowingly saved locally. 
secbot: Note: quarantine expires in 24h unless escalated. 
jamie_oncall: Good catch @taylor_forensics. For hunting, query for processes with LD_PRELOAD containing '/tmp' and size approx 230KB. Also search audit logs for execve with /tmp/.libcrypto.so. 
taylor_forensics: I'll run fleet-wide hunt and post results. If positive matches, we'll notify and enforce MDM policy to block /tmp execs. 
alex_kim: If reimage required, how do I get work back? 
priya_gupta: We'll preserve the home dir and restore via backup; dev machine reprovisioning SLA 24-48h. 
jamie_oncall: Postmortem action items: tighten LD_PRELOAD detection, add rule to block writable exec in /tmp, educate devs about pip installs from random scripts. 
alex_kim: Thank you all. 
jamie_oncall: Closing loop — taylor, drop update here when fleet hunt completes. :white_check_mark:
